Bass.coefficientRowConsMap_apply: The separated coefficient functional evaluates at a pair by multiplying the leading coordinate and adding the tail dot product; the coefficients remain on the left in this commutative-ring map.
Bass.coefficientRowLinearMap_apply: Evaluation of the one-row matrix map at its unique output index is the row dot product. This statement is over a commutative ring.
Bass.coefficientRowScalarMap_apply: The scalar-valued coefficient map evaluates to the row dot product.
Bass.ker_coefficientRowScalarMap_eq: The kernels of the scalar-valued map and its equivalent one-coordinate function-valued version agree.
Bass.mem_principalRightIdeal: Membership in the principal right ideal is exactly right multiplication of the generator by a ring element; the right module uses opposite-ring scalars.
Bass.prefixIdeal_succ: The next prefix ideal adjoins the principal ideal generated by the next sequence term.
Bass.prefixIdeal_zero: The ideal generated by the empty prefix is the bottom ideal.
Matrix.normalizedRowRank_add_of_orthogon: For two mutually annihilating idempotent square matrices, normalized row rank is additive; this equality also holds with an empty index type.
Matrix.normalizedRowRank_mem_Icc: The normalized row rank lies between zero and one when the finite square index type is nonempty.
Matrix.normalizedRowRank_mul_le_left: For nonempty finite square matrices, the normalized row rank of a product is at most that of its left factor.
Matrix.normalizedRowRank_mul_le_right: For nonempty finite square matrices, the normalized row rank of a product is at most that of its right factor.
Matrix.normalizedRowRank_one: The identity has normalized row rank one when its finite index type is nonempty; the empty-matrix case is not covered.
Matrix.normalizedRowRank_pos_iff: For nonempty finite square matrices, normalized row rank is positive exactly when the matrix is nonzero.
Matrix.normalizedRowRank_zero: The zero matrix has normalized row rank zero, including for the empty index type.
Matrix.repeatBlockHom_apply: The ring homomorphism that repeats square matrices evaluates to the corresponding repeated-block matrix; its injectivity is a separate theorem requiring nonempty blocks.
Matrix.rowRank_add_of_orthogonal_idempot: For mutually annihilating idempotents in a finite square matrix ring over a division ring, row rank is additive.
Matrix.rowRank_eq_zero_iff: A finite-row matrix over a division ring has row rank zero exactly when it is the zero matrix, even with empty column indices.
Matrix.rowRank_le_card: Row rank is bounded by the number of columns; it is the dimension of the range of the left-linear row-vector map given by right matrix multiplication.
Matrix.rowRank_mul_le_left: The row rank of a product is at most the row rank of its left factor, using the left-linear row-vector map defined by right multiplication.
Matrix.rowRank_mul_le_right: The row rank of a product is at most the row rank of its right factor, using the left-linear row-vector map defined by right multiplication.
Matrix.rowRank_one: The identity matrix has row rank equal to the cardinality of its finite index type, including the empty case.
Matrix.rowRank_pos_iff: A finite-row matrix has positive row rank exactly when it is nonzero; empty column indices are allowed.
Matrix.rowRank_zero: The zero matrix has row rank zero, including when one of its index types is empty.
